relations.text: MACOMは、Goldman Sachs Bank USAを管理代理人とするクレジット契約(2014年5月8日付)の当事者だった
relations.text_en: MACOM was party to a credit agreement dated May 8, 2014 with a syndicate of lenders and Goldman Sachs Bank USA as administrative agent

source.label: MACOM Technology Solutions 10-K
source.quote: We were party to a credit agreement dated as of May 8, 2014, with a syndicate of lenders and Goldman Sachs Bank USA, as administrative agent (as amended on February 13, 2015, August 31, 2016, March 10, 2017, May 19, 2017, May 2, 2018 and May 9, 2018, the “Credit Agreement”).
source.note: 過去の契約で、資金調達のみの関係です。

companies.name: IQE
companies.sub: 化合物半導体ウエハー

relations.text: IQEはMACOMにとって重要な供給元だ
relations.text_en: IQE is an important supplier to MACOM.

source.label: MACOM の発表
source.quote: IQE is an important supplier to MACOM.

relations.text: MACOMは、IQEへの出資を、株式と転換社債で計45百万ポンドとする方針を発表した
relations.text_en: MACOM announced a proposed investment in IQE totaling £45 million in equity and a convertible loan note

source.label: MACOM の発表
source.quote: MACOM’s proposed investment in IQE will total £45 million, in the form of equity and a convertible loan note.

companies.name: STマイクロエレクトロニクス

relations.text: MACOMとSTは、STが製造するシリコン基板上のGaNウエハーを共同開発する契約を発表した
relations.text_en: MACOM and ST announced an agreement to develop GaN on Silicon wafers to be manufactured by ST for MACOM

source.label: MACOM の発表
source.quote: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MTSI) ("MACOM"), a leading supplier of high-performance RF, microwave, millimeterwave and lightwave semiconductor products, and STMicroelectronics ( NYSE : STM), a global semiconductor leader serving customers across the spectrum of electronics applications, today announced an agreement to develop GaN (Gallium Nitride) on Silicon wafers to be manufactured by ST for MACOM's use across an array of RF applications.
source.note: 2018年の発表に基づく記載です。

companies.name: アプライド・オプトエレクトロニクス

relations.text: AOIは、100Gトランシーバーに、MACOMのCDR、ドライバー、TIAのチップセットを使う
relations.text_en: AOI will use MACOM's CDR, driver and TIA chipsets in its 100G QSFP28 transceivers

source.label: MACOM の発表
source.quote: As part of the collaboration, AOI will leverage MACOM's broad portfolio of CDRs, drivers and TIA chipsets in its QSFP28 solution.
source.note: 2016年の発表に基づく記載です。
